mentions.name: Knotend
mentions.description: A grid-based flowchart editor that replaces a free-form canvas with a grid where all nodes are the same size and sit in a cell. It adds spreadsheet-like keyboard navigation and autolayout to make editing flowcharts much faster and keyboard-centric.
mentions.source_excerpt: A new kind of grid-based flowchart editor. The design is to have a grid instead of a canvas, and all nodes are the same size and sit in a cell. On top of that, there’s keyboard navigation kind of like a spreadsheet.
mentions.author: escot
